narrative: A friend sends a link for a free gift card promotion.

message.body: Bro check this out! StoreX is giving free ₹2,000 gift vouchers for anniversary! Got mine in 2 mins: http://storex-free-voucher.info

evidence.label: StoreX Official Website
evidence.value: StoreX.com official site states no free voucher promo exists; warns of phishing link.

consequence_text.safe: Checking StoreX's official website confirmed the voucher link was a scam.
consequence_text.unsafe: Clicking gift card links spreads malware and steals personal data.

teaching_point: Free voucher claims sent via chat should be verified against official brand websites.
